about_the_game:
Mayor Life Simulator is an open-world simulation game featuring a unique combination of city management - mayorship, businesses and gang wars.

Your story begins by running a gas station in the dusty and forgotten town of RicaNo. Your ultimate goal, however, is to climb the ladder of power and become mayor of Mayorica City, where you dream big.

Players can start businesses, manage various shops, complete quests, and shape the city's economic order. During gameplay, you can drive vehicles, engage in shootouts, fight gangs, and build relationships with different factions through diplomatic decisions. As your reputation grows, the line between law and crime blurs, and when the city descends into chaos, it's up to you to take the lead. Whether you choose to rule by winning hearts, or instilling fear, this city is yours and how you rule it is entirely up to you.

Experience the ultimate mayoral simulation, the first of its kind. Mayorica City is waiting for you!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violent content themed around gang wars and organized crime. Some scenes depict gunfights and criminal environments. In addition, some areas contain erotic content, such as strip clubs, but without explicit sexuality.
